title: Analysis of murine lamina propria TH17 cells
protocol: Open intestines longitudinally and wash in PBS to remove faecal content.
Shake intestines in HBSS containing 5 mM EDTA for 20 minutes at 37°C.
Remove epithelial cells and fat tissue from the intestines.
Incubate cut tissues with RPMI1640 containing 4% FBS, 1 mg/ml collagenase type II, 1 mg/ml dispase, and 40 μg/ml DNase I for 1 hour at 37°C in a shaking water bath.
Wash digested tissues with HBSS containing 5 mM EDTA.
Resuspend the washed tissue in 5 ml of 40% Percoll.
Overlay the suspension on 2.5 ml of 80% Percoll in a 15-ml Falcon tube.
Centrifuge samples at 2,000 rpm for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Collect LP lymphocytes from the interface of the Percoll gradient.
Wash collected cells with PBS containing 0.5% BSA and 2 mM EDTA or RPMI1640.
Incubate LP lymphocytes with 50 ng/ml PMA, 5 μM calcium ionophore A23187, and Golgistop in complete media at 37°C for 4 hours.
Incubate cells with a cocktail of fluorescently labeled antibodies, such as anti-CD4 and anti-TCR-β, for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Permeabilize the cells with Cytofix/Cytoperm solution for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Incubate cells with fluorescently labeled cytokine antibodies, e.g., anti-IL-17 and anti-INF-γ, for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells with PBS containing 0.5% BSA and 2 mM EDTA buffer.
Analyze cells with a flow cytometer.
